Baby Blue by Oversee 30A | Perfect in Walton County Awards – Three-Time Diamond Winner – Best Rental Mgmt. 2026, 2025, 2024 This home has three Neighborhood Beach Accesses located along Blue Mountain Road. Baby Blue is just south of 30A, next door to the Blue Mountain Creamery. Your crew will love the open-air dining of Red Fish Taco, and the endless options at The Blue Mountain Bakery. A large private pool in the spacious outdoor area is divine. The lounge chairs and large covered deck help make this a vacation favorite. Inside, the open dining and living area share a unique layout. The spacious kitchen, next to the dining nook, is separated from the living room by a kitchen island. Stylish and cheery, the entire first floor is a must-see. One guest room, queen, and one with a bunk, a twin over twin and then a full, share a hallway full bathroom with a tub/shower combo.

The second floor has a double twin bunk room that overlooks the pool area, and a beautiful primary suite is on the opposite end. At Baby Blue, the warmth of hospitality awaits. Our dedicated team at Oversee, a local company, is committed to ensuring your stay is nothing short of exceptional. We strive for perfection and are just a stone's throw away should you require any assistance. Reach out to us anytime, seven days a week, with the added peace of a 24/7 emergency line. Overview: - 300 steps (.1 mile) to Blue Mountain Beach Access - 4 bedroom, 3 bath - 1,845 sq ft - Wi-Fi - 3 bikes included - Private pool (can be heated seasonally for an additional $55.00 per day, contact Oversee for details) Overnight: - Queen in 1st floor guest room; shared tub/shower combo; TV - 1 Full over full in 1st floor guest room and 1 twin over twin; shared tub/shower combo; TV - King in 2nd floor primary bedroom, private bath; TV (50”) - 2 twin over twin bunk in 2nd floor guest room and single twin; private bathroom; TV (32”) Check-in is 4:00 PM CST. Checkout is 10:00 AM CST.
